purpose: Inputs for property-level financial models. Every line declares claim type, confidence and basis. Lines marked ASSUMPTION are NOT evidenced and are the reason models are reported as ranges across three scenarios.

season_structure._source: Mojo Lodge Hakuba published rate card, corroborated by Hakuba Village monthly ski-visit data

shoulder_season.warning: Hakuba April ski visits fell 38.5% and May 82.7% year on year in R07-R08. Shoulder revenue is the least reliable component of any projection and is stress-tested downward in the conservative case.

low_season.note: Modelled at zero unless a market has evidenced four-season demand. Foreign stays in Hakuba are 84.6% Dec-Mar and Australian stays 97.7%.

occupancy_scenarios._basis: No property-level occupancy data exists for any candidate. Bracketed by two measured anchors: Nagano simple-lodging occupancy is 14.2% in January (the category average, including part-time and hobby operators) and Niigata resort hotels reach 64.9% in January (rank 4 nationally). A well-run, foreign-facing, professionally-marketed lodge should sit far above the first and can plausibly approach the second.
occupancy_scenarios._warning: This is the single weakest input in the model and it drives revenue linearly. Treat the spread between scenarios as the honest measure of what is not known.

rate_per_guest_night_jpy._note: Derived from whole-property rates divided by capacity and from published per-person rates. Shoulder rates use the observed low-season figures where a rate card exists.

operating_cost_rates._warning: NO Japanese operator quotes were obtained. These are industry-standard placeholders and are the second-weakest input after occupancy. Phase 16 must replace them.
operating_cost_rates.utilities_note: Snow-country heating over a four-month winter is a material cost and is charged per occupied night as a simplification.
operating_cost_rates.snow_clearing_note: Snow-country specific. Roof and access clearing across a season.
operating_cost_rates.fixed_admin_note: Tax representative (納税管理人), accounting and compliance for non-resident owners. Legally required.

owner_use.note: Master prompt assumes 2-4 weeks; 3 is used. Priced as revenue foregone at high-season rates unless the property has separate owner quarters.

not_modelled: Japanese income tax on non-resident rental income
Currency transfer costs and FX hedging
Vacancy during renovation - the first year is assumed non-trading via working capital in the capital model
